text_block_list.text:
I hope it's just my imagination. It's just... lately,
your knee looked like it was giving you trouble.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I use that too. A doctor at the hospital
who's looked after me for years recommended it.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: If it looks like you won't use it, you can just give it back.

with a somewhat sorrowful expression on her face...
